firmwareNote.title: iLO 4 Firmware Notes
firmwareNote.description: HP DL380 G9 requires patched firmware iLO 4 v2.77 Fan Hack to unlock SSH fan control commands:
firmwareNote.bayExample: Bay ID for DL380 Gen9 ranges from 0 to 5 for Fan 1 through 6. PWM values range from 0 (stopped) to 255 (100% duty cycle).
firmwareNote.note: Once applied, iLO maintains the designated fan speed without ramp-up alarms when third-party PCIe cards (e.g. GPUs or 10GbE NICs) are installed.
